data.spec: Implemented backend-only completion: POST /api/device-events type stock_low now fixed catalogue/quantity1 dispatch with scope+level validation, payload-bound idempotency and exact approval; no model call. All canonical /api/sensor values feed fixed engine; bathroom legacy prompt replaced by bathroom-stock-low. Registration precedes dispatch; startup/background tick resumes interrupted preparation but never started/uncertain supplier execution. Sound uses durable StationActions in facility_outputs. GET /api/devices/:board_id/actions {actions:StationAction[]}; POST .../actions/claim {consumer_id} atomically pending→dispatched returns {actions}; POST .../actions/:id/acknowledge {status:'delivered'|'failed',detail?}. Shared TS/schema StationAction {id,incident_id,board_id,kind:'sound',pattern:'attention',text,simulation,state:'pending'|'dispatched'|'delivered'|'failed'|'cancelled',consumer_id:null|string,created_at,updated_at,detail}. Recovery cancels pending tones. Dispatched commands never auto-replay, terminal ack immutable. Existing single hardware/voice_station consumer claims and maps pattern to actual output; queueing alone is not sound delivery. No UI edits in this completion.
